featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are a Royal Enfield purist looking for a service center that respects the machine as much as you do, this is the place.
​What sets this team apart is their absolute refusal to resort to "jugaad." In an environment where quick fixes and makeshift repairs are the norms, these guys are a breath of fresh air. They rely strictly on genuine parts and a deep, technical understanding of the RE engine—whether it's a UCE, a 650 Twin,classic 500 or the newer J-series.
​Why I recommend them:
​Zero Shortcuts: They don't believe in "patching things up." If a part needs replacement, they use original spares, ensuring the longevity of the bike.
​Problem-Solving Mastery: Their diagnostic ability is top-tier. They don't just change oil; they listen to the taps, feel the vibrations, and resolve underlying issues that authorized centers often overlook.
​Machine Knowledge: It’s clear they understand the "soul" of these motorcycles. The bike feels tighter, smoother, and more responsive after a visit.
​It is rare to find a workshop that prioritizes engineering integrity over "Indian-style" temporary fixes. If you want your Enfield to run exactly how it was designed to, trust these experts. They truly know the machine best.
Thankyou so much Johnny sir for the best service of my bike my 14 years old machine feels like brand new...

After waiting, a mechanic rode the bike and said that aside from the bent handle, the front suspension didn't have fork oil. He also said something about the chain was broken and the whole chain assembly will have to be changed.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had visited Mumbai for a week in February 2024 for official reasons. Having some time in my hand and a new city to explore I decided to rent a cycle for the week. Being used to riding my own premium quality and well serviced bikes; my expectations of finding a decent bike on rent were low. Yet I decided to venture out on the adventure of finding a good enough bike. It started out horribly as I looked up places to rent a bike on google and turned up at the first two places to find one of them shut and the owner not receiving my repeated calls and the other one only having a few dilapidated bikes.

I hit luck on the third time when I found The Cycle Expert. I spoke over the phone, they sounded professional and swift; later I turned up at the location and was prompty delivered with a Firefox bike. Run by a father and son duo, they told me they have a wide range of premium bikes to rent from including Giant, Trek and Scott but as I had contacted them very last minute and considering the frame size that would be suitable for my height this was the bike they had for me. I test rode the bike and I loved it, the shifting was buttery smooth, the brakes had bite and the ride quality was effortless.

It was a delightful experience from start to finish. The cycle was obviously in excellent condition, well-maintained and smooth to ride. I explored Mumbai for 7 days on this cycle, and not once did I encounter any issues with it.

What truly stood out was the professionalism of the owners. They were friendly, helpful, and made the entire rental process seamless. They provided me with all the necessary information and tips for cycling in Mumbai, ensuring I had a safe and enjoyable experience.
